subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Emily is a American living in Paris for her work.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "a American" i**s incorrect.
 
• The correct article to use before the word "**American**" is "**an**" because "**American**" begins with a vowel sound.
 
• The phrase should be "**an American"** for correct grammatical usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Emily is an American living in Paris for her work."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "living in Paris"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "for her work"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "Emily is"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
